_comment: The last of the twelfth tell: the four sentences the pattern still finds once
it is anchored to a sentence-opening, capitalised imperative. Every one of them
is about the reader or the paper rather than the subject, which is what makes
them worth fixing rather than exempting.

edits.why: the sentence tells the reader what demonstrating a distinction shows, which is strategy rather than the two clocks
edits.find: ; giving the physical pair and adding "and for logical ordering, Lamport timestamps and vector clocks" shows you know the distinction the syllabus is drawing.
edits.to: ; giving the physical pair and adding "and for logical ordering, Lamport timestamps and vector clocks" names both clocks and the difference between them.

edits.why: the definition is about configuration, which is the claim; the reader does not have to be told to notice it
edits.find: Notice that the definition is about configuration rather than technology:
edits.to: The definition is about configuration rather than technology:

edits.why: a heading names what the two lists are; keeping them apart in an exam is about the marking
edits.find: Two lists of five, and how to keep them apart in an exam
edits.to: Two lists of five, and how they differ

edits.why: the mapping onto the rest of the course is the fact; what a question rewards is the paper's business
edits.find: A question that asks how the unit relates to the course rewards exactly that mapping, so keep the four lines rather than the general claim.
edits.to: Each of the four is the same fundamental challenge in a new setting, which is how this unit relates to the rest of the course.
